doc.description:
live.object is used to perform operations on Live objects that have been selected using the live.path object. These operations include retrieving information on the current state of the Live API and setting values to control Live.
		
		
		Note: The Live API runs in the main thread in Live, and all messages to and from the API are automatically deferred.

methods.name: getpath
methods.digest: Send the canonical path of current object

methods.name: getinfo
methods.digest: Send a description of the current object

methods.name: bang, getid
methods.digest: Sends the id of the current Live object to the outlet

methods.name: call
methods.digest: Call the given function of the current object (optional parameter list)

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the list child to contain the given ids

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the child name to point to the given child

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the given list property to the value list

methods.name: set
methods.digest: Set the value of given property of the current object

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Send the ids of the elements of the list-child of the current object

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Send the id of the child of the current object

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Send the list of values of given property of the current object

methods.name: get
methods.digest: Output the value of a property of the current object
